Appends bytes starting at `Upload-Offset: n`. Any overlap with existing content must match byte for byte; a retry
of bytes already held is accepted and not counted again. Success confirms that the append is saved; `verified_to`
is your new confirmed cursor.

AccountView.description:
The owner's view: the account and its usage (the pools, the rate card, the per-minute rate, concurrency and
storage).

balance.description: your credit balance, used by either pool once its daily allowance is spent; null when none

entitlements.description: Account entitlements (data, ai, mcp, sessions), shared by all of the account's keys, sessions, and connected apps and narrowed by their kind

pools.description: the daily credit pools, always two in this order: `data`, then `ai`

rate_limit_per_minute.description: requests per minute for the whole account; excess requests return 429 `rate_limit_exceeded` without a charge

rates.description: the rate card, the same for every account: always three rows in this order: `input_tokens`, `output_tokens`, then `data_request`

resets_at.description: the next reset of every pool (midnight UTC), RFC 3339

tier_display_name.description: Tier name to display to users

size.description: the session's size after this request

verified_to.description: Confirmed upload offset: `Upload-Offset` plus the body's length. Advance your confirmed cursor to this value

data.description: the page's rows, in the list's order

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page; null at the end of the list

object.description: the object's type, constant for a schema (`list` for a page)

id.description: the session's id, chosen by your application: 1 to 128 characters of `A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ -`, starting with a letter or digit, unique per account and application
the application's name in the session paths (for example `tauric`)

ai.description: AI units (model-inference requests, copilot turns, research runs) in flight at once; one more is refused `429 concurrency_limit_reached`

expires_at.description: when the first of them expires (a midnight UTC), RFC 3339

granted.description: credits added by the codes still active

candidates.description: the instruments an ambiguous symbol could mean; send one of their keys

code.description: the error code (the consumer guide lists each one)

in_flight.description: how many it has in progress now

limit.description: how many runs and requests the account may have in progress at once

message.description: a human-readable explanation; do not parse it

param.description: the parameter the error is about

remaining.description: the credits left in the spent pool

resets_at.description: when the pool resets, the next midnight UTC

retry.description: `later`: request it again later (after `Retry-After` when it is sent); `never`: asking again does not change the answer; `change_request`: a different request (the message names it) can succeed

type.description: the error's class: `invalid_request_error` for a request to change, `server_error` for one to retry unchanged

base_allowance.description: credits per UTC day without the boost

ends_at.description: when the boost ends (a midnight UTC), RFC 3339

percent.description: the percentage added to the pool's allowance

allowance.description: credits per UTC day, any boost included

boost.description: an active invitation code boost on this pool; null when none

explains.description: what the pool pays for, in one line

held.description: credits reserved for work running now, beside `used` (the AI pool; 0 for data)

id.description: the pool's stable id (the 429 `quota_exhausted` names it in `pool`)

reported_tokens.description: the AI pool: today's reported tokens

RateUnit.description: What a rate is charged per.

per.description: the quantity the price is for (1,000 tokens; 1 request)

input_tokens.description: input tokens the model reported for work settled today

output_tokens.description: output tokens the model reported for work settled today

Retry.description: When asking again can succeed: later, never, or with a changed request.

offset.description: the parent's byte offset at the fork point

session_id.description: the id of the session this one forked from (an `ApplicationSessionView.id`, same account and application)

metadata.description: the session's description: at most 16 pairs, keys of 1-64 characters A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ -, values plain text of at most 512 characters. It replaces the whole map; `{}` clears it; omitted keeps it (a new session starts with `{}`).

parent.description: set at creation only (a fork); fixed afterwards

archive_bytes.description: retained session-archive bytes across all applications (does not reset daily; deleting a session releases its bytes)

used_bytes.description: stored bytes across all applications (does not reset daily; deleting a session releases its bytes)
